youtube.title: Stompy's ABC: A to E! (BOING!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦖 BOING! Stompy the dino jumped so high that all the letter blocks flew away! Can you help Stompy find them?

Learn the letters A, B, C, D and E with Stompy! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: A is for acorn, B is for bus, C is for cow, D is for dino (just like Stompy!) and E is for Earth. Visit the forest, the city, the farm, the jungle and outer space! Then sing the letter song with Stompy, and stay till the end, because somebody comes hopping in with the next letter! ✨

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters A, B, C, D and E
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (C is for cow!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a happy alphabet song with Stompy the dino!
